example_flowchart.code:
flowchart TD
    A(["開始"]) --> B["使用者輸入帳號密碼"]
    B --> C{"帳號密碼正確？"}
    C -->|是| D["建立登入工作階段"]
    C -->|否| E["顯示錯誤訊息"]
    E --> B
    D --> F(["結束"])

example_sequence.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor U as 使用者
    participant W as 網頁前端
    participant S as 後端服務
    participant D as 資料庫
    U->>W: 輸入帳號密碼
    W->>S: POST /api/login
    S->>D: 查詢使用者資料
    D-->>S: 回傳使用者資料
    alt 驗證成功
        S-->>W: 回傳 token
        W-->>U: 進入首頁
    else 驗證失敗
        S-->>W: 401 錯誤
        W-->>U: 顯示錯誤訊息
    end

example_state.code:
stateDiagram-v2
    state "草稿" as Draft
    state "審核中" as Submitted
    state "已核准" as Approved
    state "已退回" as Rejected
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Submitted : 送出
    Submitted --> Approved : 核准
    Submitted --> Rejected : 退回
    Rejected --> Draft : 修改後重送
    Approved --> [*]

example_usecase.code:
usecase-beta
    direction LR
    actor U1("一般使用者")
    actor U2("管理員")
    systemBoundary SYS("訂單系統")
        UC1("查詢訂單")
        UC2("建立訂單")
        UC3("審核訂單")
    end
    U1 --> UC1
    U1 --> UC2
    U2 --> UC3
    UC2 ..>:include UC1

example_component.code:
flowchart LR
    subgraph FE["前端"]
        WEB["Web 介面"]
    end
    subgraph BE["後端服務"]
        API["API 閘道"]
        SVC["訂單服務"]
    end
    DB[("訂單資料庫")]
    EXT["外部金流系統"]
    WEB -->|HTTPS| API
    API --> SVC
    SVC --> DB
    SVC -->|REST| EXT

example_deployment.code:
flowchart TB
    USER(("使用者"))
    subgraph DMZ["DMZ 區"]
        LB["負載平衡器"]
    end
    subgraph APP["應用程式區"]
        AP1["AP 主機 1"]
        AP2["AP 主機 2"]
    end
    subgraph DATA["資料區"]
        DB[("資料庫主機")]
    end
    USER -->|HTTPS 443| LB
    LB --> AP1
    LB --> AP2
    AP1 --> DB
    AP2 --> DB
